**Fan-made.** Not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve.

embeds.title: 📜 Server Rules
embeds.description: Short and simple. Break a rule and you'll get a warning, a timeout or a ban, depending on how bad it is.

fields.name: 1. Be kind
fields.value: No harassment, hate speech, slurs or pile-ons. Banter is fine, bullying isn't.

fields.name: 2. Virtual money only
fields.value: Everything in CS2 Case Simulator is virtual. No buying, selling or trading items, accounts or in-game money for real money, here or in DMs, and no links to real-money trading or gambling sites.

fields.name: 3. No scams or sketchy links
fields.value: No phishing, fake giveaways, "free skins", IP loggers or link shorteners, and no pretending to be staff, Steam or Valve. Scams get an instant ban.

fields.name: 4. Keep it SFW
fields.value: No NSFW, gore or shock content. That includes names and profile pictures.

fields.name: 5. No spam or self-promo
fields.value: No ads, server invites or DM advertising. Want to share something? Ask a mod first.

fields.name: 6. Right channel, right post
fields.value: Pulls go in {{channel:unboxings}}, questions in {{channel:help}}, bugs in {{channel:bug_reports}}, ideas in {{channel:suggestions}} and trades in {{channel:trade_offers}}.

fields.name: 7. No cheats or ripped files
fields.value: Don't share cheats for real CS2, pirated software or files taken from CS2's install. The game reads your own copy, so there's never a reason to.

fields.name: 8. Listen to the mods
fields.value: If a mod asks you to stop, stop. Disagree? Message a mod calmly and we'll talk it through. Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines apply here too.

embeds.footer: Fan-made, not affiliated with Valve. Thanks for keeping this place friendly.

embeds.title: 🔒 Stay safe from scams
embeds.description:
CS2 scammers love servers like this one. These are always true here:

• **Nobody will ask for your Steam or Discord login,** or your Steam Guard code. Not staff, not the developer, not "Valve".
• **"I accidentally reported you" is always a scam.** So is anyone sending you to a "Steam admin" to sort it out.
• **Nobody is giving away real CS2 skins.** Giveaway links, QR codes and "claim your knife" sites are phishing.
• **The game is only posted in {{channel:releases}}.** A "new version" or "beta" sent to you in DMs is not from us. Don't run it.
• **Check every link.** Real Steam lives at steamcommunity.com and store.steampowered.com. One wrong letter means it's fake.

Got a weird DM or link? Don't click it. Screenshot it and ping a {{role:moderator}}.
embeds.footer: When in doubt, ask a mod first.

embeds.title: 🚀 Getting started
embeds.description:
**1. Download** the latest build from {{channel:releases}}. The **installer** sets up for your user (no admin needed) and starts fast. The **portable exe** needs no install but starts slower.
**2. Run it.** Windows SmartScreen may warn you because the exe isn't signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
**3. Got CS2 installed?** You'll want it: Play mode, the only way to earn money, needs it, and so do inspect on real CS2 models and the 3D crate drop. Cases, inventory, trading and the Market work without it, starting from $10.
**4. Be online the first time.** Item images download the first time you see them, then they're cached.

embeds.title: 📦 Open cases
embeds.description:
42 real weapon cases, 150 souvenir packages, the X-Ray, Anubis and Terminal packages, 229 sticker and autograph capsules and an Agent Locker. Each one opens with CS2's own unlock reel, and with CS2 installed, weapon cases and recent souvenir packages drop in as CS2's 3D crate first. Keys are bought separately, just like in CS2.

Every skin you unbox gets its own float and pattern seed, and everything you unbox gets a serial number, so blue gems, fades and Doppler phases are all out there.

embeds.title: 🎒 Your inventory
embeds.description: Sort by Quality like CS2 and equip a loadout: gloves, knife, agents and one skin per gun. Inspect in 3D on real CS2 models, apply stickers, hang any of the 78 charms and watch your StatTrak counters climb. The **Item Database** works like CSFloat's, with float ranks.

embeds.title: 🔄 Trade ups, the Armory and the Market
embeds.description:
**Trade Up Contracts** follow CS2's rules.
**The Armory** rotates its featured collections every 10 to 15 minutes. Spend Armory Stars on its drops.
**The Market** uses prices blended from Skinport, CSFloat, Buff163 and YouPin.

embeds.title: 🤝 Traders, friends and battles
embeds.description:
**2,000 NPC players** live in the game. They trade with you, message you offers and haggle, and collectors chase blue gems, low floats and more.
**Friends and chat** work like Steam's, with profiles and an item showcase.
**Case battles** (1v1 to 2v2), **coinflip** and **jackpot** use virtual money and are provably fair. Play them against bots, or online against other players.

embeds.title: 🎯 Play mode
embeds.description:
Offline CS2 matches against bots on real maps from your CS2 install (Dust II, Mirage, Inferno, Nuke, Ancient, Anubis, Overpass, Train, Vertigo, Cache and more), with your equipped skins. Queue **Premier, Competitive, Wingman, Deathmatch or Arms Race** and climb ranks and CS Rating against bots, or set up a **private match**.

**This is how you earn money:** $250 for a win or draw, $100 for a loss, $20 per kill and $10 per assist. Matches also give XP toward profile levels 1 to 40, Service Medals, and a care package every level up.

embeds.title: 🌐 Online mode (optional)
embeds.description:
Make an account on a server to trade with real players and join live case battle, coinflip and jackpot lobbies. Online accounts start fresh and stay separate from your offline save. Click **Offline** at the top right of the game to connect.

When there's a community server to join, its address goes up in {{channel:announcements}}.

**Link your Discord:** online, click your name at the top right, then **Link Discord**. Type `/link` here with the code the game shows, and press **Link** on the bot's reply. Forgot your password? Type `/resetpassword` here for a reset code, then use **Forgot password?** in the game.
embeds.footer: More questions? The FAQ is right below.

embeds.title: ❓ FAQ

fields.name: Is this real money?
fields.value: No. Money, keys, items and gambling are all virtual. There are no real-money purchases, and nothing can be cashed out or sold for real money.

fields.name: Is this made by Valve?
fields.value: No. It's a fan-made game, not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve.

fields.name: Do I need CS2 installed?
fields.value: For most of it, no: cases, inventory, trading and the Market work without it. But Play mode, where you earn money, needs it, and so do inspect on real CS2 models and the 3D crate drop. Nothing from CS2 comes bundled with the game. It reads your own install.

fields.name: Why does Windows warn me?
fields.value: The exe isn't code-signed, so SmartScreen flags it. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Only do this for builds from {{channel:releases}}.

fields.name: How do I earn money?
fields.value: Play matches in Play mode (needs CS2 installed): $250 for a win or draw, $100 for a loss, $20 per kill and $10 per assist. Each level up brings a care package, and selling on the Market or trading with NPCs helps too.

fields.name: Is Play mode online multiplayer?
fields.value: No. Play mode is offline matches against bots, with your equipped skins. Online mode is for trading and live case battle, coinflip and jackpot lobbies.

fields.name: Do I have to go online?
fields.value: No, online mode is optional. Offline you still have 2,000 NPC players who trade with you, send you offers and haggle.

fields.name: How do I link my game account?
fields.value: Online, click your name at the top right → **Link Discord**, then type `/link` here with the code. Only you can see the bot's answer. `/profile` shows anyone's linked account, and `/unlink` undoes it.

fields.name: Mac, Linux or mobile?
fields.value: No, the game is Windows only.

fields.name: Where's my save?
fields.value: `%APPDATA%/cs2-case-sim/save.json`. Copy it somewhere safe if you want a backup.

fields.name: Found a bug or have an idea?
fields.value: Bugs go in {{channel:bug_reports}}, ideas in {{channel:suggestions}}. Screenshots help!

embeds.footer: Still stuck? Ask in the help channel.

embeds.title: 🎲 Find a lobby
embeds.description:
Looking for an online case battle, coinflip or jackpot? Post here. Copy this to get started:
```
Mode: 2v2 case battle
Cases: 3x Kilowatt Case
Username: yourname
```
The game works out what each player pays from the cases. Nobody around? You can always play against bots in the game.

fields.name: Virtual money only
fields.value: Every round is provably fair, and you can check it with the **Verify fairness** button in the game. It's all in-game money, just for fun. Never send anyone real money, gift cards or Steam items.

embeds.footer: Keep it friendly, win or lose.

embeds.title: 🛡️ Staff quick guide
embeds.description: The short version of how we run things.

fields.name: Where things land
fields.value: AutoMod alerts and Discord safety alerts go to {{channel:mod_log}}. Discord's community updates go to {{channel:discord_updates}}.

fields.name: Warn, timeout, ban
fields.value: Warn first for normal rule breaks, then time out, then ban. Scams, malware and real-money deals go straight to a ban.

fields.name: The game's admin panel
fields.value: Link your game account with `/link`, and **More → Admin** appears in the game: players, bans, kicks, warnings, notes, snapshots and the audit log. {{role:developer}} can also edit stats and items and change the server's settings. From Discord: `/game lookup`, `ban`, `unban`, `kick` and `warn`. Everything you do is logged in {{channel:mod_log}}.

fields.name: Hacked accounts
fields.value: Most scam posts come from hacked accounts. Ban with message deletion to clear the spam, then unban so they can come back once they've secured their account, and tell them why.

fields.name: AutoMod
fields.value: Fake Steam and Discord links are blocked for mods too, and the sender gets a 1 hour timeout. The alert-only rule flags things like "free skins", "Steam admin" or crypto for a human to check, so look before you act.

fields.name: Forums
fields.value: Tag bug reports Needs Info, Known Issue or Fixed. Tag suggestions Under Review, Planned, Added or Not Planned.

fields.name: Say thanks
fields.value: Tell the developer who should get {{role:bug_hunter}} (people whose reports helped fix real bugs).
